descriptions.dashboard: A first look at agency activity: portfolio, commercial follow-up, outstanding records and commissions. Every indicator comes from the fictional dataset.
descriptions.properties: Explore six fictional properties with combined filters and sorting. Open a record to add temporary local photos and PDFs. Owner management, assignments and real publication are planned.
descriptions.crm: Planned scope: leads, buyers, sellers, tenants, owners and investors; pipeline, assignments, reminders and communication history.
descriptions.partners: Planned scope: partner agencies, introducers, developers, referrals, agreements and commission tracking, with access restricted to authorized information.
descriptions.documents: Open a record to manage local files for its linked property. Secure server collection, categories, verification, expiry, versions and access history are planned. Record statuses remain fictional.
descriptions.contracts: Planned scope: sale and rental mandates, partner agreements, templates, versions, approvals, multilingual PDFs and electronic signatures.
descriptions.finance: Planned scope: transactions, contractual commission rules, agency/agent/partner distribution, invoices, payments, expenses and currencies.
descriptions.appointments: Planned scope: viewing calendar, agent assignments, reminders, reports and handovers linked to the client and property.
descriptions.team: Planned scope: users, employees, nine roles, granular permissions and role-based access. These fictional profiles are not login accounts.
descriptions.reports: Planned scope: sales activity, agent and partner performance, revenue, outstanding balances and document completeness. No real exports are produced yet.
descriptions.settings: Planned scope: agency, locations, seven languages, currencies, storage, templates and integrations. No real settings or secrets are exposed.
descriptions.activity: Planned scope: traceable changes, approvals, sensitive access and financial operations. The events shown here are fictional.
